title: Implementing CPF Lifetime Retirement Investment Scheme to Enable CPF Members an Option for Higher Expected Returns
what_it_is: Implementing CPF Lifetime Retirement Investment Scheme to Enable CPF Members an Option for Higher Expected Returns

sections.label: CPF Investment Scheme funds
sections.summary: Members who want higher returns can invest CPF savings through low-cost funds under the CPF Investment Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Dr Tan See Leng)
sentences.text: In the meantime, members who wish to invest their CPF savings for potentially higher returns can already do so through a number of low-cost funds under the CPF Investment Scheme.

sections.label: Publicity for retirement products
sections.summary: Once details of further support for retirement planning products are finalised, publicity initiatives will be rolled out to educate CPF members.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: When we have finalised the details of the provision of further support, in terms of planning their retirement through products, striking this optimal balance between risk and return, we will contemporaneously roll out publicity initiatives to educate the broad masses of our CPF members, hoping that they will benefit from it.

sections.label: Safeguarding retirement adequacy
sections.summary: The penultimate objective has always been to safeguard retirement adequacy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: For us, the penultimate objective has always been to safeguard retirement adequacy.

sections.label: Market downturn and retirement adequacy
sections.summary: An investor who liquidated investments for retirement during a market downturn could see a significant drop in asset value affecting retirement adequacy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: When we launch a particular product, any investor who had to liquidate his or her investment for retirement needs during a market downturn would have experienced, depending on how long he has been invested for, a significant drop in his asset value and that can impact adversely his retirement adequacy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: But I think, in reality, looking forward is a more difficult endeavour.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: But like I said, we are in the final stages.

sections.label: Lifetime Retirement Investment Scheme details
sections.summary: Details of the Lifetime Retirement Investment Scheme are close to being finalised and will be announced at the appropriate time.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chua Kheng Wee Louis (Sengkang)
sentences.text: After all, it was back in 2016 when the Lifetime Retirement Investment Scheme was being accepted by the Government, and while we may be considering a various range of options when it comes to investing one's CPF, whether the Lifetime Retirement Investment Scheme still features in it and whether we can still expect an update by this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: I have shared earlier on that we are close to finalising the details.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We will announce it at the appropriate time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We have taken guidance from the CPF Advisory Panel and we are in the process of studying how we can incorporate some of the features, because, obviously, a certain time has passed and the markets have also evolved.

sections.label: Product weightages on equities and bonds
sections.summary: The product's construct will take into account different weightages on global equities versus bonds.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: The construct of the product will take into account different weightages on global equities versus bonds.
